openings.claim: Manual inspection of every stage in timestamp order may be unnecessary for reporting an earliest supported divergence or unresolved interval.
openings.delta: Remove the sequential manual-scan dependency. A local script joins supplied records by manifest stage and artifact boundary, compares available paired digests, and emits a ledger containing record identifiers, equality, inequality and missing evidence. Expected order supplies an indexing convention, not proof of execution or causality.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, ordinary timestamp-ordered manual comparison, the indexed workflow should avoid placing the anomalously early export before parse solely because of its timestamp. After transform-record removal, it should widen an unresolved interval when necessary rather than infer nonexecution. These are predicted differences, not measured results.
openings.probe: Use the two disjoint three-pair subsets. Both variants consume the same supplied records through scripted tables; log every human record inspection across both variants, capped at twelve per pair. Freeze both ledgers before opening the two answer sheets. Compare supported boundary claims, unresolved intervals, citation validity, inspection counts and agreement with whichever pairs the sheets identify. Limit initial work to sixty minutes and variant comparison to the additional twenty. Apply the stipulated removals during final review and revise evidence before freezing.
assumptions: Manifest identifiers and the dictionary permit matching the same artifact boundary across runs; ambiguous matches remain unresolved.
Script construction and checks fit the available time. Otherwise the proposed removal is not feasible.
Answer-sheet coverage may be incomplete; unsupported general performance claims remain unavailable.

assessment: Only cite a definite divergent stage when supplied unequal boundary records and affirmative evidence for preceding expected boundaries support it. Otherwise report the interval between the last supported equal boundary and first supported unequal boundary, using an open endpoint where evidence is absent. Separate mismatches from explanations and preserve the timestamp conflict explicitly. Next checks inspect retained adjacent input digests and dictionary boundary definitions within the remaining inspection budget. Defeat: ambiguous boundary correspondence, absent preceding evidence, time exhaustion, or either variant exceeding twelve inspections. This probe tests removal of one workflow dependency; it proves neither the converse nor its inverse and authorizes no deployment.
